resources.string: Close EKA2L1 first. Choose its complete folder or a ZIP containing data/devices.yml, roms and drives. Games, installed components and saves are copied together. External memory-card mounts are not included: their contents must be inside the selected drives folder. Android may block access to another app’s private folder; use an exported copy in that case.
A complete, readable EKA2L1 folder is required, not only Drive E or individual games. Export the whole folder if Android blocks nested folders.
Select the phones to copy. Each gets its own writable drives. Completed copies and original files stay unchanged.

%1$s
Phone data: %2$d MB

Games and saves will be added as a separate phone. Existing phones are not merged or overwritten. Reimporting this same snapshot reuses its previous copy and keeps newer saves.
The copied phones are available in the library. Original files are unchanged. Game compatibility is not guaranteed.
A saved phone-transfer queue is available. Review it to continue only unfinished work.
Remove this queue and its temporary source copy? Phones already imported and their saves will be kept.
Phone already copied. Retry will only add it to the library.

Phone data: %2$d MB

%3$s

Each phone is added separately. Existing phones and saves are not replaced. Completed copies will not be repeated. Shared drives may be copied for each selected phone.
